correctness.rationale: The exact source root was algebraically reduced to a monotone scalar equation. The right logarithmic tail is uniformly negligible at order one over dimension, bounded transition parameters converge to a unique limiting root, and divergent transition parameters force the normalized root into the quadratic regime. For a fixed class parameter, coefficient matching gives the first two terms and the exact derivative controls the remainder by the mean-value theorem.
